statement: For a contiguous subarray nums[l..h] with 0 <= l <= h < len(nums), let OR(l,h) denote the bitwise OR of nums[l], nums[l+1], ..., nums[h]. Whenever the function returns a result ans, ans is the length of a shortest special non-empty contiguous subarray, or -1 if no special subarray exists: (1) if there exists a pair (l,h) with 0 <= l <= h < len(nums) and OR(l,h) >= k, then 1 <= ans <= len(nums), there exists such a pair with h-l+1 = ans, and every such pair satisfies h-l+1 >= ans; (2) if no such pair exists, then ans = -1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: For every nums and k satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result ans; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, either ans = -1 or 1 <= ans <= len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans with ans > 0, there exists an integer l such that 0 <= l, l + ans - 1 < len(nums), and the bitwise OR of nums[l], nums[l+1], ..., nums[l+ans-1] is at least k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans with ans > 0, every non-empty contiguous subarray nums[l..h], where 0 <= l <= h < len(nums), whose bitwise OR is at least k has length h - l + 1 >= ans.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans with ans = -1, every non-empty contiguous subarray nums[l..h], where 0 <= l <= h < len(nums), has bitwise OR strictly less than k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, ans = 1 if and only if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] >= k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Let FullOR be the bitwise OR of all elements nums[0], nums[1], ..., nums[len(nums)-1]. Whenever the function returns a result ans, ans = -1 if and only if FullOR < k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans and len(nums) = 1, ans = 1 if nums[0] >= k, and ans = -1 if nums[0] < k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans with ans = len(nums), the bitwise OR of all elements nums[0], nums[1], ..., nums[len(nums)-1] is at least k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans and k = 0, ans = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans and every element of nums is 0, ans = 1 if k = 0 and ans = -1 if k > 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= k < 64.
